en: The privacy policy below is kept in its original Traditional Chinese. Email the studio if you need an explanation in another language.
zh: 以下隱私政策保留繁體中文原文。若需要其他語言的說明，請寄信聯絡工作室。

en: The website privacy notice is available in Traditional Chinese and English.
zh: 網站隱私說明提供繁體中文及英文版本。

en: This is the app’s existing privacy policy, with the contact address updated to firesparkle.studio@gmail.com. References to the old site concern the original support site. For this website, see the website privacy notice.
zh: 以下沿用此 App 既有的隱私政策，聯絡信箱已更新為 firesparkle.studio@gmail.com。原文提及舊網站時，指的是原支援網站。本官網的資料處理請見網站隱私說明。

en: This existing notice covers the app’s information webpage only, not all data handling within the app. Email us for details about app data, storage or deletion.
zh: 這份原有隱私說明僅涵蓋作品介紹網頁，未完整說明 App 內的資料處理。若需要了解 App 的資料、儲存或刪除方式，請寄信給我們。

en: In-app purchases and subscriptions are handled by Apple. Manage them in iPhone Settings → your name → Subscriptions. Refunds are requested through Apple’s Report a Problem and reviewed by Apple. Deleting an app does not cancel its subscription.
zh: 若 App 提供 Apple App 內購買或訂閱，可在 iPhone「設定 → 你的姓名 → 訂閱項目」管理。退款請透過 Apple 回報問題提出，是否符合退款條件由 Apple 審核。刪除 App 不會自動取消訂閱。

en: Visit the privacy centre and choose the app or game. For questions about accessing, correcting or deleting data, email us and include the product name.
zh: 前往隱私中心，選擇對應作品即可查看。若有資料存取、更正或刪除問題，請來信並註明作品名稱。

en: Email us with the app name and what happened. Storage and backup differ by app, and some data lives only on your device, where we cannot access or restore it. Check the app’s backup options before deleting or reinstalling.
zh: 請先來信說明 App 名稱與狀況。各 App 的儲存與備份功能不同，部分資料只保存在你的裝置上，開發者可能無法存取或還原；刪除或重裝前，請先確認該 App 的備份方式。
